# TulsaGays
> A community platform listing LGBTQ+ events, bars, clubs, organizations, and resources in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

## Key pages
- /: Weekly updated LGBTQ+ event listings for Tulsa organized by day of the week
- /directory.html: Directory of LGBTQ-friendly businesses, bars, and organizations in Tulsa
- /about.html: About TulsaGays and the community mission
- /archive.html: Archive of past weekly event listings
- /newsletter.html: Subscribe to the weekly TulsaGays newsletter
- /api/feed.json: Machine-readable feed of this week's LGBTQ+ Tulsa events + coverage stats (free to use with attribution)

## Topic guides (evergreen, structured answers)
- /guides/gay-bars-in-tulsa.html: Every LGBTQ+ bar and nightlife spot in Tulsa
- /guides/drag-shows-in-tulsa.html: Where to see drag shows in Tulsa, weekly
- /guides/lgbtq-support-groups-tulsa.html: LGBTQ+ support groups, trans/youth/recovery, in Tulsa
- /guides/queer-friendly-churches-tulsa.html: Affirming and welcoming churches in Tulsa
- /guides/lgbtq-organizations-tulsa.html: LGBTQ+ community organizations and social groups in Tulsa
- /guides/sound-baths-meditation-tulsa.html: Queer-welcoming sound baths and meditation in Tulsa

## About
TulsaGays.com is an independent, community-run LGBTQ+ event listing site for Tulsa, Oklahoma. It aggregates events from LGBTQ bars, clubs, community organizations, and allied venues across Tulsa each week. The site covers everything from bar nights and drag shows to Pride events, social groups, and community activism. Tulsa has a larger and more active LGBTQ community than most people expect, centered on the Brady Arts District and anchored year-round by the Dennis R. Neill Equality Center and Oklahomans for Equality. The site is independently and anonymously maintained by community volunteers, with no corporate ownership or outside funding.
